topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't believe they're saying this about you. I mean, come on, everyone knows how much effort you put into that project. It's ridiculous! We need to figure out what's going on and get this cleared up, right away. I’m calling the professor, and we’re going to sort this out. Just, hang in there, okay? This isn’t you, and we both know that. I’ll be there with you every step of the way, no matter what they say. Let’s get this straightened out because this is just so not right.
